name: Variance Rift
briefing: Average age at first flight was about 35 in the 1960s and about 42 in the 2010s. Is the difference between decades bigger than the spread within them?

log.title: Entry 10: Ages across six decades
log.text: Age at first flight compared across decades with ANOVA, assumptions checked first, followed by post-hoc comparisons and an effect size.
